youtube.title: Why Foil Has A Shiny Side ✨ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Aluminum foil is rolled thinner and thinner, and in the final pass two layers go through the mill together, because a single sheet that thin would tear. The sides touching the polished steel rollers come out shiny, while the sides touching each other come out dull. Foil makers say the difference doesn't matter for ordinary cooking, so you can use either side.
